basic_info.description: Urban luxury at LUMINA, just steps from SF's Embarcadero waterfront. This modern open-concept space offers premium upgrades across its 1,098 sq. ft. floor plan. Enjoy a spacious primary suite with a large walk-in closet and luxurious en-suite, the convenience of TWO full baths, and a spacious den that easily converts into a guest space. Seamless indoor-outdoor living awaits with floor-to-ceiling windows and a city-view deck, while stylish oak flooring and ceramic tiled bathrooms add sophistication. The chef-grade kitchen boasts artful cabinetry, Caesarstone countertops, and top-of-the-line Gaggenau appliances. Bosch washer & dryer and NEST technology enhance daily living. Indulge in over 45,000 sq. ft. of resort-style amenities, including a 7,000 sq. ft. fitness center, heated indoor pool, and movie theater. With over one acre of luxury amenities, LUMINA sets the standard for upscale living in San Francisco.
